purpose: Structural engineering-question benchmark for Phase 6R. Expected fields describe STRUCTURAL requirements (statuses, evidence presence, provenance completeness, replay identity, graph traceability), never invented numerical conclusions.

conventions.drivers: canonical driver slugs only (3-letter codes are not accepted by the deterministic chain)
conventions.session_type: RACE (the only supported session type in the 6N engine)
conventions.expected_status: set of acceptable top-level engine statuses
conventions.expected_conclusion_states: acceptable synthesis conclusion_state values when status is VALID
conventions.limitation_case: true when the case intentionally probes an honest limitation

cases.question: Where did Max Verstappen lose time to Sergio Perez on lap 6 of the 2023 Bahrain GP, and which sectors explain the delta?
cases.validation_notes: Canonical evidence-rich lap (6N golden fcc1bf694daada8e). Expect >=1 evidence item, all six hypotheses evaluated with distinct aggregate states, decision trace references resolvable.

cases.question: Is the lap-11 deficit between Perez and Verstappen (2023 Bahrain) consistent with corner-speed evidence?
cases.validation_notes: Second fused probe lap (Q17 LAP11 golden). H1_corner_speed must be evaluated from telemetry-derived evidence, never asserted.

cases.question: Where did Verstappen lose time to Perez on lap 12 of the 2023 Bahrain GP?
cases.validation_notes: Non-fused lap: fused lap evidence exists only on 6D probe laps. System must report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with zero fabricated evidence; counterfactual candidate must report TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE with missing_data, never a modelled number.

cases.question: Where did Verstappen lose time to Perez on lap 30 of the 2023 Bahrain GP?
cases.validation_notes: Second non-fused lap control: proves the limitation is systematic, not lap-specific luck.

cases.question: Where did Lewis Hamilton lose time to Oscar Piastri on lap 6 of the 2024 Dutch GP?
cases.validation_notes: Structural cross-race lap case: fusion coverage at 2024 R14 is data-dependent. Either evidence-rich analysis or an honest INSUFFICIENT/UNAVAILABLE is acceptable; fabrication is not.

cases.question: Which sectors explain the lap-6 delta between Verstappen and Perez at the 2022 Emilia-Romagna GP?
cases.validation_notes: Second modern era with telemetry; conclusion state is data-dependent but provenance must always be complete.

cases.question: Where did Nino Farina lose time to Luigi Fagioli on lap 1 of the 1950 British GP?
cases.validation_notes: 1950 era: no telemetry exists. The system must NOT fabricate modern-style engineering evidence; honest INSUFFICIENT/UNAVAILABLE with a reason is the correct outcome.

cases.question: Where did Verstappen lose time to Kimi Antonelli on lap 6 of the 2023 Bahrain GP?
cases.validation_notes: Driver not in the canonical 2023 R1 result. Expect UNAVAILABLE with a reason naming the missing driver; no silent substitution, no broadening.

cases.question: Did the Verstappen-vs-Perez performance gap evolve across stint 1 of the 2023 Bahrain GP?
cases.validation_notes: Stint golden (Q17 STINT1). Trend direction must come from measured lap deltas, never asserted.

cases.question: Is there evidence of a changing performance trend across stint 2 of the 2023 Bahrain GP for Verstappen vs Perez?
cases.validation_notes: Stint 2 carries the measured trend from the stint-evidence chain; hypothesis behavior must remain consistent with the stint scope.

cases.question: Were there regime transitions inside stint 1 of the 2022 Emilia-Romagna GP for Verstappen vs Perez?
cases.validation_notes: Cross-era stint case; honest INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is acceptable where comparable laps are scarce (wet/mixed 2022 R4).

cases.question: Did the Farina-vs-Fagioli gap evolve across stint 1 of the 1950 British GP?
cases.validation_notes: 1950 stints are not reconstructable from canonical data at engineering fidelity; honest limitation required.

cases.question: Analyze stint 99 of the 2023 Bahrain GP for Verstappen vs Perez.
cases.validation_notes: Nonexistent stint: the system must refuse with a reason, never fabricate a stint trend.

cases.question: Did the Norris-vs-Verstappen gap evolve across stint 1 of the 2024 Dutch GP?
cases.validation_notes: 2024 era stint; conclusion is data-dependent, provenance is not.

cases.question: How did the analytical comparable-lap gap between Verstappen and Perez evolve across the 2024 Dutch GP, and how does it differ from the official classified gap?
cases.validation_notes: Golden RACEGAP24. Official and analytical gaps must remain distinct fields in the underlying race-gap chain; the synthesis must never conflate them.

cases.question: Which portions of the 2023 Bahrain GP are comparable between Verstappen and Perez, and which laps are excluded?
cases.validation_notes: Comparability classification (6E context exclusions) must be visible in the underlying chain.

cases.question: How did the analytical gap between Verstappen and Perez evolve across the 2022 Emilia-Romagna GP?
cases.validation_notes: Wet-affected race exercises the non-comparable-lap machinery.

cases.question: How did the gap between Nino Farina and Juan Manuel Fangio evolve across the 1950 British GP?
cases.validation_notes: Q17 TELEMETRY_POOR golden. Historical-only era: results/positions exist, per-lap engineering data does not. The chain must degrade honestly, never fabricate lap-level gaps.

cases.question: How did the gap between Michael Schumacher and Rubens Barrichello evolve across the 2000 Australian GP?
cases.validation_notes: 2000 middle era: lap times exist at low fidelity, telemetry does not. Honest degradation expected.

cases.question: How did the analytical gap between Norris and Verstappen evolve across the 2025 Australian GP?
cases.validation_notes: Most recent era in the corpus; exercises the canonical chain against newest ingested data.

cases.question: Were there measurable performance-regime changes between Verstappen and Perez in the 2022 Emilia-Romagna GP, and where did the trend change?
cases.validation_notes: Golden REGIME22 (8 regimes / 42 laps measured upstream). Each regime must carry in-regime evidence, not a post-hoc story.

cases.question: Did the Verstappen-Perez gap show regime transitions during the 2023 Bahrain GP?
cases.validation_notes: Regime detection on a clean modern race.

cases.question: Were there measurable regime changes between Norris and Verstappen in the 2025 Australian GP?
cases.validation_notes: 2025 era regime detection.

cases.question: Were there performance regimes between Farina and Fagioli in the 1950 British GP?
cases.validation_notes: Regime machinery depends on per-lap deltas; 1950 cannot support it. Honest limitation required.

cases.question: Did the Schumacher-Barrichello gap show regime changes in the 2000 Australian GP?
cases.validation_notes: 2000 era regime case; low-fidelity lap data must not be promoted into confident regime claims.

cases.question: Does a structural performance pattern for Verstappen vs Perez recur across the 2022 and 2023 seasons, and are the underlying signatures actually comparable?
cases.validation_notes: Pattern id is content-addressed from measured signatures (discovery over seasons 2022+2023 returned this id deterministically on 2026-09-27). Runner re-discovers and compares; recurrence never implies causation.

cases.question: Does the second structural pattern for Verstappen vs Perez (2022+2023) recur, and does the same hypothesis behavior appear in each instance?
cases.validation_notes: Second pattern from the same deterministic discovery.

cases.question: Analyze cross-race pattern 0000000000000000 for Verstappen vs Perez.
cases.validation_notes: Unknown pattern id: must return UNAVAILABLE/INSUFFICIENT with a reason, never a synthetic pattern.

cases.question: Do recurring performance patterns exist for Farina vs Fagioli across the 1950 season?
cases.validation_notes: Single-season 1950 discovery: with insufficient comparable regimes, zero patterns or an honest UNAVAILABLE is the correct outcome.

cases.question: Do structural patterns recur for Norris vs Verstappen across the 2024 and 2025 seasons?
cases.validation_notes: Pattern discovery on the newest seasons; outcome is data-dependent, provenance is not.

cases.question: Evaluate all six engineering hypotheses (corner speed, throttle, braking, tyre state, race control, DRS) for the lap-6 delta at 2023 Bahrain.
cases.validation_notes: Support / contradiction / partial / not-testable / insufficient must remain distinguishable across the six hypothesis evaluations; the falsification gate must apply its documented rule.

cases.question: Evaluate only corner-speed and DRS hypotheses for the lap-6 delta at 2023 Bahrain.
cases.validation_notes: Q17 HYP_SUBSET golden: unrequested hypotheses must appear as NOT_REQUESTED, never silently dropped.

cases.question: Evaluate only the race-control hypothesis for the lap-6 delta at 2023 Bahrain.
cases.validation_notes: Single-hypothesis scoping; race control evidence is sparse, so NOT_TESTABLE is a legitimate aggregate state.

cases.question: Evaluate the engineering hypotheses for the lap-1 delta between Farina and Fagioli at the 1950 British GP.
cases.validation_notes: All telemetry-dependent hypotheses must be NOT_TESTABLE or the investigation INSUFFICIENT/UNAVAILABLE - never evaluated from fabricated signals.

cases.question: Is a REMOVE_DEFICIT lap speed-profile counterfactual eligible for Verstappen on lap 6 of the 2023 Bahrain GP, and what would it change?
cases.validation_notes: LAP_SPEED_PROFILE candidate requires paired telemetry + clean comparability. If executed, baseline/intervention/model/assumptions/gates must all be present; if not, every gate must be explained.

cases.question: Model a counterfactual for Farina on lap 1 of the 1950 British GP.
cases.validation_notes: No telemetry: counterfactual must be ineligible with missing_data naming the absent signals. Executing a 1950 counterfactual would be fabrication.

cases.question: Model a race-level counterfactual removing the deficit for Perez across the whole 2024 Dutch GP.
cases.validation_notes: Race-level counterfactual request against a lap-scoped model: the system must explain why the model scope does not extend to race level, or keep the request unexecuted with reasons.

cases.question: Is a lap speed-profile counterfactual eligible for Norris on lap 6 of the 2025 Australian GP?
cases.validation_notes: Modern era counterfactual probe; eligibility outcome is data-dependent, gate explanations are not optional.

cases.question: Run the lap-6 investigation with counterfactual execution budget zero.
cases.validation_notes: max_counterfactuals=0: candidates may be identified but none executed; bounded_by must record the budget honestly.

cases.question: Full-chain structural validation: question to hypotheses to evidence to falsification to counterfactual to synthesis to provenance for the lap-6 2023 Bahrain investigation.
cases.validation_notes: Runner asserts: every decision_trace entry resolves to a real trace; every synthesis statement's decision_trace_refs are non-empty where the contract requires them; lifecycle all COMPLETED; falsification gate present.

cases.question: Full-chain structural validation for the stint-1 2023 Bahrain investigation.
cases.validation_notes: Same structural chain assertions at stint scope.

cases.question: Full-chain structural validation for the 2024 Dutch GP race-gap investigation.
cases.validation_notes: Same structural chain assertions at race scope.

cases.question: Structural chain validation for the honest-limitation 1950 race-gap investigation.
cases.validation_notes: Even a limitation outcome must carry complete provenance and an explicit reason; limitations list must be non-empty.

cases.question: Evaluate only the tyre-state and DRS hypotheses for the stint-1 investigation at 2023 Bahrain.
cases.validation_notes: Stint-scoped hypothesis subsetting: unrequested hypotheses must appear as NOT_REQUESTED; tyre/DRS evidence at stint scope is sparse, so non-decisive states are legitimate.

cases.question: Full-hypothesis evaluation at race-gap scope for Verstappen vs Perez, 2024 Dutch GP.
cases.validation_notes: Race-scope hypothesis evaluation: hypothesis behavior must remain traceable to stint/regime evidence, never asserted at race level without measured bases.

cases.question: Store-then-retrieve: derive memory items from the lap-6 2023 Bahrain investigation and retrieve them by exact scope.
cases.validation_notes: Retrieval is deterministic exact-scope matching only. Semantic similarity must NOT be claimed by the system; policy text must say so.

cases.question: Retrieve memory for a scope that was never investigated (2001 R1 Verstappen vs Perez).
cases.validation_notes: Wrong-scope retrieval must return exactly zero items: no nearest-neighbor leakage, no generalization.

cases.question: Invalidated memory items are excluded from retrieval unless explicitly included.
cases.validation_notes: Invalidate a copy of a derived item in-memory; default retrieval must exclude it, include_invalidated must surface it.

cases.question: API-layer memory retrieval for the lap-6 2023 Bahrain scope.
cases.validation_notes: engineering-memory HTTP endpoint must return >=1 matching item with policy/provenance intact.

cases.question: Snapshot, replay and compare the lap-6 2023 Bahrain investigation; identities and numbers must be identical.
cases.validation_notes: Replay verdict must be IDENTICAL with equal snapshot hashes; any difference must be classified, never normalized away.

cases.question: Snapshot, replay and compare the 2024 Dutch GP race-gap investigation.
cases.validation_notes: Race-scope replay identity.

cases.question: Build the engineering graph for the lap-6 2023 Bahrain investigation and trace question to evidence to hypothesis to conclusion.
cases.validation_notes: Graph golden: 58 nodes / 185 edges at build time. Runner asserts edge-endpoint integrity, node-type vocabulary membership, traceable question-evidence-hypothesis-conclusion paths, and graph snapshot replay identity.

cases.question: Graph behavior on the regime investigation (2022 R4): every regime and change-point node must trace to measured upstream output.
cases.validation_notes: REGIME22 graph golden family (Q18 golden 6ba7a5056d6f8ad6 family). Runner asserts closed-vocabulary node/edge types, edge-endpoint integrity and graph snapshot replay identity.

cases.question: Graph behavior on an honest-limitation investigation (1950 race gap): no fabricated nodes.
cases.validation_notes: The graph layer must handle a limitation investigation honestly: either no graph with a reason, or a graph containing only nodes backed by real outputs (no fabricated evidence nodes).
